# curl compatibility — `org.ono.compat.curl`

Version `0.1.0`; process.exec executables: `curl`. Everything below is the pack's contract; an invocation not listed under an adapter runs raw, and the limits state what the adapted form does not carry.

## curl — `org.ono.compat.curl.curl`

An HTTP exchange as one `ono.http-exchange/1` record — metadata from curl's write-out, the body as bytes.

| | |
|---|---|
| executable | `curl` |
| versions | `>=7.75` |
| tier | B — stable machine-readable format |
| schema | `ono.http-exchange/1` |
| decoder | `curl-exchange-v1` |
| demand | structured |
| fallback | error |
| fixtures | `curl/curl` |

### Supported invocations

| invocation | runs as | flags allowed | flags required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `adapt curl [-L] [-k] [-f] [-4\|-6] [--compressed] [-X <method>] [-d <data>] [-m <seconds>] <url …>` | `curl -s -S -w %{http_code}	%{content_type}	%{size_download}	%{time_total}	%{url_effective}	%{remote_ip}	%{remote_port}	%{scheme}	%{num_redirects}
` | `-s`, `-S`, `-L`, `--location`, `-k`, `--insecure`, `-f`, `--fail`, `-4`, `-6`, `--compressed`, `--http1.1`, `--http2`, `--no-progress-meter`, `-X <value>`, `--request <value>`, `-d <value>`, `--data <value>`, `--data-raw <value>`, `--data-binary <value>`, `-m <value>`, `--max-time <value>`, `--connect-timeout <value>`, `--retry <value>`, `-A <value>`, `--user-agent <value>`, `-e <value>`, `--referer <value>` | — |

### Limits

- The body is buffered into the record: this adapter answers a structured demand only, and a plain `curl` stays the streaming bytes it always was (spec v0.3 §1.41).
- `-H`, `-u`, `--user`, `-b`, `--cookie`, `-o`, `-O`, `-w`, `-D`, `-i`, `-I`, `-v` and `--config` run raw: headers and credentials never enter provenance or history.
- Redirect chains and TLS details are not fields; they wait for schema semantics of their own.
